strings.tierB.home.title: FieldSales: Software na Van Sales kple Sales Reps
strings.tierB.home.description: Software na numalawo: invoice kple receipt tso sales rep ƒe fon dzi, van stock, gaxɔxɔ, mɔwo kple sasrãkpɔwo. Ewɔa dɔ internet manɔmee, ewɔa sync emegbe.
strings.tierB.home.h1: Kpɔ wò sales reps dzi tso sasrãkpɔ gbãtɔ va se ɖe gaxɔxɔ mamlɛtɔ
strings.tierB.home.definition: FieldSales nye cloud platform (van sales kple sales rep software) na distribution kple wholesale dɔwɔha siwo ƒe sales reps wɔa dɔ le mɔ dzi. Sales reps wɔa invoice kple receipt le woƒe fon dzi eye wotaa wo, wokpɔa van stock dzi eye woŋlɔa woƒe sasrãkpɔwo; dɔdzikpɔlawo (managers) kpɔa nudzadzra, gaxɔxɔ kple fe si le asisi ɖe sia ɖe dzi le ɣeyiɣi si me wole dzɔdzɔm la.
strings.tierB.home.capabilities.0.title: Invoice tso sales rep ƒe fon dzi
strings.tierB.home.capabilities.0.line: Sales rep wɔa invoice la le asisi ƒe nudzraƒe ʋɔtru nu, eye wòtaa e kple Bluetooth thermal printer hafi wòadzo le nudzraƒe la.
strings.tierB.home.capabilities.1.title: Gaxɔxɔ kple fe si le asisiwo dzi
strings.tierB.home.capabilities.1.line: Gaxexe ɖe sia ɖe xɔa receipt si dzi xexlẽdzesi le, si wotsɔ ku ɖe invoice siwo wòxe ŋu, eye asisi ƒe fe kple eƒe statement trɔna enumake.
strings.tierB.home.capabilities.2.title: Van stock ƒe dzikpɔkpɔ
strings.tierB.home.capabilities.2.line: Wokpɔa van ɖe sia ɖe ƒe stock dzi nu ɖeka ɖeka: nu si wode eme, nu si wodzra, nu si wotrɔ gbɔ kple nu si susɔ, eya ta ne nane bu la, àkpɔe gbe ma gbe.
strings.tierB.home.capabilities.3.title: Mɔwo kple sasrãkpɔwo
strings.tierB.home.capabilities.3.line: Woŋlɔa sasrãkpɔ ɖe sia ɖe kple teƒe, ɣeyiɣi kple fotowo, eye dɔdzikpɔla kpɔa sales rep ɖe sia ɖe ƒe mɔ le map dzi.
strings.tierB.home.capabilities.4.title: Ewɔa dɔ ne internet meli o
strings.tierB.home.capabilities.4.line: Sales reps yia edzi le nu dzram ne network meli o gɔ̃ hã. Agbalẽwo nɔa fon la dzi lalam, eye ne network gbugbɔ va la, woyina server dzi le wo ɖokui si, eye ɖeke meyina zi eve o.
strings.tierB.home.capabilities.5.title: Web dashboard na dɔdzikpɔlawo
strings.tierB.home.capabilities.5.line: Nudzadzra, gaxɔxɔ, nu siwo wotrɔ gbɔ, stock kple sales rep ɖe sia ɖe ƒe dɔwɔwɔ, wo katã le teƒe ɖeka, kple roles kple permissions na amesiame si zãa e.
strings.tierB.home.howItWorks.0.title: Gblɔ ale si nèdzraa nu la na mí
strings.tierB.home.howItWorks.0.line: Bia quote alo ɖo takpekpe. Míakpɔ wò sales reps, wò mɔwo, wò nuwo kple invoice ŋuti nu siwo hiã wò.
strings.tierB.home.howItWorks.1.title: Ɖo wò dɔwɔha la ɖe ɖoɖo me
strings.tierB.home.howItWorks.1.line: De wò nuwo, woƒe asiwo, asisiwo kple sales reps eme, eye nàɖo wò dukɔ ƒe ga kple adzɔ ƒe agbɔsɔsɔ (tax rate) ɖe settings me.
strings.tierB.home.howItWorks.2.title: Ɖo sales reps ɖe mɔ dzi
strings.tierB.home.howItWorks.2.line: Sales reps tsɔa app la dea woƒe Android alo iPhone dzi, wodea nu woƒe van me, eye wodzea nudzadzra, invoice tata kple gaxɔxɔ gɔme.
strings.tierB.home.howItWorks.3.title: Kpɔ ale si ŋkeke la le yiyim
strings.tierB.home.howItWorks.3.line: Web dashboard la ɖea nudzadzra, gaxɔxɔ, van stock kple sasrãkpɔwo fiana esime sales reps gale mɔ dzi.
strings.tierB.home.faq.0.a: FieldSales nye cloud platform na sales reps dzikpɔkpɔ le distribution kple wholesale dɔwɔhawo me. Edoa alɔ van sales, route sales, pre-sales (order xɔxɔ do ŋgɔ) kple direct store delivery (DSD). Sales reps wɔa invoice eye wotaa wo, woxɔa ga eye woŋlɔa sasrãkpɔwo le woƒe fon dzi, eye dɔdzikpɔlawo kpɔa nudzadzra, gaxɔxɔ, van stock kple fe si le asisiwo dzi le web dashboard dzi.
strings.tierB.home.faq.1.q: Ɖe FieldSales wɔa dɔ ne internet meli o a?
strings.tierB.home.faq.1.a: Ɛ̃. Sales rep ƒe app la yia edzi le dɔ wɔm ne internet meli o: sales reps wɔa invoice kple receipt eye wotaa wo, woŋlɔa sasrãkpɔwo eye wodea asisi yeyewo eme, eye ne network gbugbɔ va la, wo katã yina server dzi le wo ɖokui si, eye ɖeke meyina zi eve o. Nu ɖeka koe to vovo le Saudi Arabia: dɔwɔha siwo ʋu e-invoicing kadodo la, internet hiã wo le ɣeyiɣi si me wole invoice alo return wɔm.
strings.tierB.home.faq.2.a: FieldSales subɔa distribution dɔwɔhawo le dukɔ ɖe sia ɖe me. Dɔwɔha ɖe sia ɖe ɖoa eya ŋutɔ ƒe ga kple adzɔ ƒe agbɔsɔsɔ ɖe eƒe settings me, eye invoices, receipts kple reports zãa wo. FieldSales ƒe nɔƒe le Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, eye míekpena ɖe ŋuwò nàdze egɔme le internet dzi: to takpekpewo, WhatsApp kple kpekpeɖeŋu tso didiƒe.
strings.tierB.home.faq.3.q: Ɖe FieldSales ate ŋu aku ɖe dziɖuɖu ƒe e-invoicing systems ŋu a?
strings.tierB.home.faq.3.a: Míedoa alɔ Phase 2 ƒe kadodo kple ZATCA ƒe Fatoora platform la. Esia ku ɖe dɔwɔha siwo le Saudi Arabia ŋu. Le dukɔ bubuwo me, Ghana kple Togo hã, FieldSales wɔa invoice siwo dzi wò ga kple wò adzɔ ƒe agbɔsɔsɔ le, eye kadodo kple dukɔ la ƒe dziɖuɖu e-invoicing system li ne èbiae, ne míekpɔ dukɔ ma ƒe se siwo hiã kpli wò vɔ. Ŋugbedodo aɖeke meli be wòawɔ ɖe se dzi le Saudi Arabia godo o.
strings.tierB.home.faq.4.q: FieldSales app la le gbe kawo me?
strings.tierB.home.faq.4.a: FieldSales app la ƒe interface le Arabiagbe, Eŋlisigbe, Fransegbe, Turkigbe kple Chinagbe me, eye mele gbe bubu aɖeke me o. Eʋegbe mele eme o, gake Eŋlisigbe kple Fransegbe le wo dome. Sales reps kple dɔdzikpɔlawo ate ŋu atrɔ interface la ƒe gbe, eye woate ŋu ata invoice ɖe sia ɖe le gbe eve me: gbe gbãtɔ kple gbe evelia aɖe. Website ƒe axa siwo le gbe bubuwo me, abe Eʋegbe axa sia ene, nye gɔmeɖeɖewo na nyatakaka le software la ŋu.
strings.tierB.home.faq.5.a: Bia quote, ɖo takpekpe alo ŋlɔ na mí le WhatsApp dzi. Míase ale si wò sales reps wɔa dɔ gɔme, eye míakpe ɖe ŋuwò nàɖo wò nuwo, woƒe asiwo, asisiwo kple sales reps ɖe ɖoɖo me. Sales reps tsɔa app la dea Android alo iPhone dzi, eye dɔdzikpɔlawo zãa web dashboard la le browser ɖe sia ɖe me. Smartphone koe nye dɔwɔnu si hiã wò.
strings.tierB.home.cta.whatsapp: Ƒo nu kple mí le WhatsApp dzi
strings.tierB.home.uiLanguagesNote: FieldSales app la ƒe interface le Arabiagbe, Eŋlisigbe, Fransegbe, Turkigbe kple Chinagbe me; Eʋegbe mele eme o. Axa siwo le gbe bubuwo me ɖea software la gɔme na nyatakaka ko.
strings.tierB.category.title: Van Sales Software na Numalawo | FieldSales
strings.tierB.category.description: Van sales kple route sales software: sales rep taa invoice tso fon dzi, van stock nu ɖeka ɖeka, gaxɔxɔ kple sasrãkpɔwo. Ewɔa dɔ internet manɔmee.
strings.tierB.category.h1: Van sales software na numalawo kple wholesalers
strings.tierB.category.intro: FieldSales nye van sales software na dɔwɔha siwo ƒe sales reps dzraa nu tso ʋu me le mɔ dzi gbesiagbe. Sales rep dea nu van la me, edzraa nu le nudzraƒe ɖe sia ɖe, etaa invoice, exɔa ga eye eŋlɔa nu siwo wotrɔ gbɔ, wo katã le fon app ɖeka dzi. Dɔdzikpɔla kpɔa nu si wode van ɖe sia ɖe me, nu si wodzra, ga si woxɔ kple nu si susɔ.
strings.tierB.category.sections.0.title: Nukae nye van sales software?
strings.tierB.category.sections.0.body: Van sales software, si woyɔna hã be cash van alo route sales software, kpɔa nudzadzra ƒe mɔnu aɖe dzi: sales rep tsɔa stock ɖe ʋu me, eye edzraa nu, etsɔa nu naa asisi, ewɔa invoice eye exɔa ga le sasrãkpɔ ɖeka me. Exɔa invoice agbalẽ siwo wotsɔ asi ŋlɔ kple fon yɔyɔ siwo wowɔna le fiẽ me teƒe. Eŋlɔa nudzadzra ɖe sia ɖe, gaxexe ɖe sia ɖe kple nu ɖe sia ɖe si wotrɔ gbɔ abe agbalẽ ene, eya ta àte ŋu atsɔ stock kple ga asɔ kple wo nɔewo gbe ma gbe. Na dɔdzikpɔla, eɖoa nyabiase etɔ̃ ŋu fiẽ sia fiẽ: nukae sales rep ɖe sia ɖe dzra, ga nenie wòxɔ, eye nukae susɔ le van ɖe sia ɖe me?
strings.tierB.category.sections.1.title: Ŋkeke ɖeka le mɔ dzi
strings.tierB.category.sections.1.body: Ŋkeke la dzea egɔme kple nuwo dede van me tso nudzraɖoƒe, eye woŋlɔa esia ɖi ɖe agbalẽ dzi. Le nudzraƒe ɖe sia ɖe, sales rep ʋua asisi la ƒe nyatakakawo, edea nuwo eme tso list alo barcode dzi, ewɔa invoice eye wòtaa e kple thermal printer. Woŋlɔa gaxexe kple receipt, eye ne wotrɔ nane gbɔ la, woŋlɔa susu si ta wotrɔe gbɔ. Le ŋkeke la ƒe nuwuwu, nu siwo susɔ le van me la, wotrɔa wo yia nudzraɖoƒe. Le ɣeyiɣi ma katã me, dɔdzikpɔla ate ŋu akpɔ sales rep ɖe sia ɖe ƒe nudzadzra, gaxɔxɔ kple sasrãkpɔwo le web dashboard dzi, eye mehiã be wòayɔ ame aɖeke o.
strings.tierB.category.sections.2.title: Wowɔe na teƒe siwo network mesesẽ le o
strings.tierB.category.sections.2.body: Distribution mɔwo tona xɔ ƒe anyigbame xɔwo, dɔwɔƒe gãwo ƒe nutowo kple kɔƒe siwo network mesesẽ le o me. FieldSales sales rep ƒe app la dzraa nyatakakawo ɖo ɖe fon la dzi (asisiwo, nuwo kple woƒe asiwo), eya ta sales rep ate ŋu awɔ agbalẽwo eye wòata wo internet manɔmee. Dzesi tɔxɛ (unique key) le agbalẽ ɖe sia ɖe si, eya ta eyina server dzi zi ɖeka ko, ne wogbugbɔ dze agbagba gɔ̃ hã. Le Saudi Arabia la, dɔwɔha siwo ʋu e-invoicing kadodo la, internet hiã wo le ɣeyiɣi si me wole invoices kple returns wɔm. Receipts, sasrãkpɔwo kple asisi yeyewo yia edzi le dɔ wɔm internet manɔmee na wo hã.
strings.tierB.category.sections.3.title: Gaxɔxɔ kple van ƒe dzikpɔkpɔ
strings.tierB.category.sections.3.body: Ele be woakpɔ ga si le mɔ dzi la dzi abe ale si wokpɔa stock dzi ene. Gaxɔxɔ ɖe sia ɖe xɔa receipt si dzi xexlẽdzesi le, si woate ŋu atsɔ aku ɖe invoice siwo wòxe ŋu, eye asisi ƒe fe trɔna enumake. Wobua van stock nu ɖeka ɖeka: nu si wode eme, ɖe nu si wodzra ɖa le eme, tsɔ nu siwo wotrɔ gbɔ kple trɔtrɔ siwo woŋlɔ ɖi kpe ɖe eŋu, eya ta dɔdzikpɔlawo ate ŋu atsɔe asɔ kple xexlẽ ŋutɔŋutɔ hafi sales rep nayi aƒe. Woate ŋu ama returns ɖe ƒomevi etɔ̃ me: nyuitɔ, gbegblẽtɔ alo ɖɔlitɔ (exchange), eye dɔdzikpɔla ye tsoa nya me ne nu siwo wotrɔ gbɔ la agbugbɔ ayi van ƒe stock si woate ŋu adzra me.
strings.tierB.category.sections.4.title: Dɔwɔha siwo wòsɔ na
strings.tierB.category.sections.4.body: FieldSales sɔ na numalawo kple wholesalers siwo dzraa nu siwo wodzrana kaba (FMCG), abe nuɖuɖu, nunono, nu siwo wotsɔ klɔa nu kple ŋutilãdzikpɔnuwo ene, kple dɔwɔha ɖe sia ɖe si ƒe sales reps yia nudzraƒewo le mɔwo dzi. Edoa alɔ van sales, pre-sales orders kple direct store delivery. Menye ERP blibo o: eku ɖe wò akɔntabubu alo ERP system ŋu to API dzi. Dɔdzikpɔlawo tsoa nya me le nu si sales rep ɖe sia ɖe ate ŋu awɔ ŋu, abe asi ɖeɖe le eme (discount), nu dzadzra le asi si woɖo ƒe te alo asisi yeyewo dede eme ene.
strings.tierB.category.faq.0.q: Vovototo kae le van sales kple pre-sales dome?
strings.tierB.category.faq.0.a: Le van sales me la, sales rep tsɔa stock, etsɔa nu naa asisi, ewɔa invoice eye exɔa ga le sasrãkpɔ ɖeka me. Le pre-sales me la, sales rep xɔa order, eye nudzraɖoƒe la tsɔa nuwo vana emegbe. FieldSales doa alɔ wo eve siaa, eya ta dɔwɔha ate ŋu azã cash vans le mɔ aɖewo dzi eye wòaxɔ orders le mɔ bubuwo dzi. Le wo eve siaa me la, invoices, gaxɔxɔ kple fe si le asisiwo dzi le system ɖeka me, eye dɔdzikpɔlawo kpɔa wo le reports ɖeka me.
strings.tierB.category.faq.1.q: Aleke mawɔ van ƒe akɔnta le ŋkeke la ƒe nuwuwu?
strings.tierB.category.faq.1.a: FieldSales ɖea nu ɖe sia ɖe si le van ɖe sia ɖe me fiana: agbɔsɔsɔ si wode eme, si wodzra, si wotrɔ gbɔ kple si susɔ. Tsɔ si susɔ la sɔ kple xexlẽ ŋutɔŋutɔ, ŋlɔ vovototo ɖe sia ɖe ɖi abe trɔtrɔ si woŋlɔ ɖi ene, eye nàtrɔ nu susɔewo ayi nudzraɖoƒe zi ɖeka. Le ŋkeke si kplɔe ɖo me la, van la dzea dɔ gɔme kple akɔnta si le dzadzɛ eye nènyae nyuie.
strings.tierB.category.faq.2.q: Dɔwɔnu kawoe van sales rep hiã?
strings.tierB.category.faq.2.a: Smartphone, Android alo iPhone. Bluetooth thermal printer mehiã kokoko o; ena sales rep ate ŋu atsɔ invoice alo receipt si wota la na asisi. FieldSales medzraa dɔwɔnu siawo o, eye mebia be nàzã printer ƒomevi tɔxɛ aɖe o. Dɔdzikpɔlawo zãa web dashboard la le kɔmpiuta alo fon ƒe browser ɖe sia ɖe me.
strings.tierB.category.faq.3.q: Ɖe FieldSales ate ŋu aku ɖe mía ƒe akɔntabubu system ŋu a?
strings.tierB.category.faq.3.a: Ɛ̃. FieldSales naa API, eye esia naa wò akɔntabubu alo ERP system ate ŋu aɖɔli asisiwo, nuwo, invoices, receipts kple stock ƒe yiyi kple vava ƒe nyatakakawo kple platform la. Wò dɔwɔha ƒe amewo alo integrator aɖe wɔa kadodo la to API documentation la dzi.
strings.tierB.countries.title: FieldSales le Dukɔwo Me: Ga, Adzɔ kple E-Invoicing
strings.tierB.countries.description: FieldSales wɔa dɔ na numalawo le dukɔ ɖe sia ɖe me. Kpɔ dukɔ ɖe sia ɖe ƒe ga, adzɔ kple e-invoicing ƒe nɔnɔme le table ɖeka me.
strings.tierB.countries.intro: FieldSales subɔa distribution dɔwɔhawo le dukɔ ɖe sia ɖe me. Dɔwɔha ɖe sia ɖe tiaa eƒe dukɔ, eƒe ga kple eƒe adzɔ ƒe agbɔsɔsɔ le eƒe settings me, eye invoices, receipts kple reports dzea wo yome. Dziɖuɖu ƒe e-invoicing kadodo le dɔ wɔm le Saudi Arabia ɖeɖeko. Le dukɔ bubu ɖe sia ɖe me la, eli ne èbiae. Table si le ete la ɖea dukɔ ɖe sia ɖe ƒe ga, adzɔ alo VAT ƒe agbɔsɔsɔ si wozãna zi geɖe, kple ne dziɖuɖu ƒe e-invoicing kadodo le dɔ wɔm alo eli ne èbiae la fiana.
strings.tierB.countries.einvoicingLive: Míedoa alɔ Phase 2 ƒe kadodo kple ZATCA ƒe Fatoora platform la
strings.tierB.countries.taxNote: Dɔwɔha ɖe sia ɖe ɖoa ga kple adzɔ ƒe agbɔsɔsɔ ɖe eya ŋutɔ ƒe settings me. Agbɔsɔsɔ siwo le table sia me nye mɔfiame ko eye woate ŋu atrɔ; kpɔ se siwo li fifia kple wò adzɔ ŋuti aɖaŋuɖola. Dzesi (—) fia be agbɔsɔsɔ si wozãna zi geɖe aɖeke mele table sia me na dukɔ ma o.
strings.tierB.about.title: Ku ɖe FieldSales ŋu
strings.tierB.about.description: FieldSales wɔa cloud software na distribution dɔwɔha siwo ƒe sales reps wɔa dɔ le mɔ dzi. Woɖo FieldSales anyi le ƒe 2026 me le Riyadh, Saudi Arabia.
strings.tierB.about.body.0: FieldSales (eƒe ŋkɔ le Arabiagbe me nye فيلد سيلز) nye cloud platform na distribution kple wholesale dɔwɔha siwo ƒe sales reps wɔa dɔ le mɔ dzi. Woɖo FieldSales anyi le ƒe 2026 me, eye eƒe nɔƒe le Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. Esubɔa dɔwɔhawo le dukɔ ɖe sia ɖe me, eye dɔwɔha ɖe sia ɖe ɖoa eƒe dukɔ ƒe ga kple adzɔ ƒe agbɔsɔsɔ ɖe eya ŋutɔ ƒe settings me. Mía ƒe asisiwo nye dɔwɔha siwo dzraa nu eye wotsɔa nuwo yia asisiwo gbɔ to sales reps siwo le mɔ dzi la dzi: numalawo, wholesalers kple manufacturers siwo si woawo ŋutɔ ƒe nudzadzra ʋuwo le.
strings.tierB.about.body.1: Míewɔa system ɖeka si kpɔa mɔ dzi dɔwɔwɔ katã dzi: invoices siwo sales rep taa tso eƒe fon dzi, receipts kple fe si le asisiwo dzi, van stock ƒe dzikpɔkpɔ, mɔwo kple sasrãkpɔwo (teƒe kple fotowo hã le eme), kpakple web dashboard na dɔdzikpɔlawo. Sales rep ƒe app la wɔa dɔ le Android kple iPhone dzi, eyia edzi le dɔ wɔm internet manɔmee, eye ne network gbugbɔ va la, ewɔa sync. Dɔwɔhawo ate ŋu atsɔ FieldSales aku ɖe woƒe akɔntabubu alo ERP system ŋu to API dzi, eya ta mehiã be woaŋlɔ mɔ dzi nyatakakawo zi eve o.
strings.tierB.about.body.2: Míeƒoa nu tso software la ŋu abe ale si wòle ene. Míedoa alɔ Phase 2 ƒe kadodo kple ZATCA ƒe Fatoora platform la. Kadodo kple dziɖuɖu ƒe systems le dukɔ bubuwo me la, eli ne èbiae. App la ƒe interface le Arabiagbe, Eŋlisigbe, Fransegbe, Turkigbe kple Chinagbe me; Eʋegbe mele eme o. Ne èdi be nàƒo nu kple mí la, bia quote, ɖo takpekpe alo ŋlɔ na mí le WhatsApp dzi.
strings.tierB.contact.title: Ƒo nu kple FieldSales
strings.tierB.contact.description: Ƒo nu kple FieldSales ƒe dɔwɔlawo: bia quote, ɖo takpekpe alo ƒo nu kple mí le WhatsApp dzi tso field sales kple van sales software ŋu.
strings.tierB.contact.intro: Gblɔ ale si wò sales reps dzraa nu egbe kple nu si nèdi be nàtrɔ la na mí. Bia quote, ɖo takpekpe alo ŋlɔ na mí le WhatsApp dzi, eye mía ƒe dɔwɔla aɖe aɖo eŋu na wò. Mía ƒe asisi siwo li xoxo ate ŋu azã mɔ siawo ke ne kpekpeɖeŋu hiã wo. Ne èyɔ wò dukɔ, wò sales reps ƒe xexlẽme, kple ne wodzraa nu tso van me, woxɔa orders alo wowɔa wo eve siaa la, esia akpe ɖe mía ŋu.
strings.tierB.contact.meetingIntro: Ɖo takpekpe kple mía ƒe dɔwɔlawo le internet dzi. Míaɖe sales rep ƒe ŋkeke ɖeka afia wò le app la me eye míaɖe dɔdzikpɔla ƒe dashboard hã afia wò, kple kpɔɖeŋu siwo te ɖe wò nuwo kple wò mɔwo ŋu. Míaɖo wò nyabiase siwo ku ɖe ɖoɖowɔwɔ ŋu la hã ŋu.
